desde: NE1 (corregida tras cine-reviewer modo 2: relleno, escala vertical, bokeh, expresión)

llave.fuente: one thin glass tile lit from within with azure-white light (#0375DB), standing upright on her raised left palm, its glowing face turned toward her cheek and away from the camera, so the camera sees it at a steep angle as a narrow blazing slab, never its full face
llave.lado: from the side of her face, level with her chin, on the right side of the frame
llave.distancia: about twenty centimetres to the side of her cheek, exactly level with the plane of her face, neither in front of it nor behind it
llave.tamano: small: no taller than her ear

primerPlano: one unlit dark glass tile hanging in the air very close to the lens on the LEFT edge of the frame, level with her shoulders and upper chest, large, soft and completely out of focus, cut by the frame edge, catching no light
fondo: rows of identical dark glass tiles from one to six meters behind and beside her, at the height of her chest and waist, each showing only a faint cold edge-line, receding into the haze, and further back a low row of large round COLD blue-white practical lights melted into big soft bokeh discs; the row of bokeh discs sits at the height of her chest plate, clearly below her shoulders, nothing is warm, amber or golden

fenomeno.que: among thousands of identical dark glass tiles, ONE has ignited azure-white and already rests on her palm while every other tile in the vault is still dark
fenomeno.esServicio: Nexa, la agente de IA de Efeonce, busca en todo lo que la marca sabe y trae la respuesta antes que nadie: la única tarjeta encendida en su mano ES la respuesta encontrada; sin ella sólo queda una mujer en un archivo oscuro

escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster poster still, vertical, with real depth of field: the instant Nexa finds the answer first, inside a vast dark data vault at night): Nexa stands CENTERED in the frame, framed from the chest up. Divide the frame height into three equal bands. The TOP band holds nothing of her: the top of her hair begins a little BELOW the line between the top and middle bands. Her eyes are just above the horizontal center line of the frame and her chin is clearly below it. Below her chin the frame shows her neck, both shoulders and her upper chest plate with its small isotype fully visible; the blurred top of the console crosses her body a hand's width BELOW that isotype and never touches it. Her LEFT hand (on the right side of the frame) is raised beside her face, OUTSIDE the outline of her body: the elbow low at her side, the forearm rising past her shoulder and never crossing her chest plate, the palm open and level with her chin about twenty centimetres to the side of her cheek. On her palm stands ONE thin glass tile no taller than her ear, upright, lit from within: its face turned toward her cheek blazes azure-white and the camera sees its glowing edge and the light shining through the glass, the brightest thing in the frame; a narrow gap of dark air separates it from her cheek and it never covers any part of her face. Her right arm hangs relaxed at her side below the frame edge: a single hand action, the raised arm visible from shoulder to fingertips. LIGHT: the lit tile is the only key light on her: hard, from the side and slightly below, at the height of her chin, so the right side of her face (on the right of the frame), her glasses, her raised hand and the edge of her left shoulder plate glow azure; her chest plate receives only a grazing side light, so the small navy isotype stays crisp navy on white, never tinted, washed out or flattened, while the left side of her face falls into deep shadow, almost black, with the nose shadow legible on her cheek: a face in two tones. The dividing line between light and shadow runs straight down the bridge of her nose and the middle of her lips: everything of her face on the right of that line is azure, everything on the left of it is as dark as the vault behind her, and no neutral, white or warm light touches any part of her face. The LED line on her glasses is a thin, dim thread that lights nothing on her skin. NO fill light, NO front light, no light at all from the camera side. A low cool rim light from behind traces only the outline of her hair and shoulders; it never reaches the shadow side of her face. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: the camera is about three meters away at chest height with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, nothing foreshortened, she does not lean toward the lens; her head is about one fifth of the frame height and her shoulders are clearly wider than two head-widths. Her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and she looks straight into the lens through her clear glasses with calm conviction; her head is level, not tilted to either side, her mouth closed in a calm, firm line with only the faintest smile, never a smirk, razor-thin focus on her eyes. She wears the bionic suit exactly as in its reference, WITH the small navy Efeonce isotype inlaid on her chest plate on her left side exactly as in the reference and the macro (no other logo, no lettering), the bionic glasses exactly as in their reference, small GOLD earrings. The navy knit sleeve and the white forearm plate of the suit run down to the base of her raised hand, so her left wrist is covered: NO watch and NO device on it, and the ONLY glowing rectangle in the whole frame is the tile; NO bracelet and NO ring on the raised hand. The suit's knit stays deep navy, never royal blue, even where the azure light touches it. THE VAULT: thousands of identical thin dark glass tiles hang perfectly still in long rows on BOTH sides of her and behind her, from one to six meters away, at the height of her chest and waist only, never above her shoulders. Every one is unlit; each catches only a faint, thin cold edge-line from the far practical lights, so on both sides of her body the eye counts dozens of dark rectangles in rows that grow softer with distance: they read clearly as thousands of dark tiles, never as an empty black void. Only the tile on her palm is lit: every other tile in the vault is still dark, as if nobody else has found it yet. The tiles are glass, never paper: no books, no shelves, no cards with writing, no screens with interfaces. Far back, a low row of large round COLD blue-white practical lights at waist height melts into big soft bokeh discs. Thin haze catches the glow of the lit tile. GEOGRAPHY: her face is in the center of the frame width; the lit tile sits just beyond the right edge of her face, level with her chin, with dark air between it and her cheek; her shoulders fill the middle half of the frame width; the dark unlit tile near the lens on the left edge, level with her shoulders, is the only foreground element. The TOP third of the frame is calm, cool, deep navy-black vault air with only faint haze and visible texture, never warm or brown: no tiles, no particles, no ceiling lights, no beams and no bright spots up there. Nexa is the only person in the whole vault: no other people anywhere, not even far away or out of focus. COLOUR TEMPERATURE: the whole frame is cool and contemporary: every light in it is azure or cold blue-white; nothing is warm, amber, orange or golden except her small earrings; no tungsten, no retro glow. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, awe-inspiring. No logos of any other brand, no readable text.

lecho.objeto: the near-black matte rubber near edge of a long reading console that runs from the camera toward her, the lens only a few centimetres behind that near edge; it crosses the whole width of the bottom of the frame, completely out of focus, its blurred top passing a hand's width below the small isotype on her chest plate; matte, with no reflections, no glints on its edge, no screens and no light reaching it

texto.muro: calm, deep dark vault air above her head, with only faint haze and visible texture
